comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Acquiring this title seems to require:

Obtaining Veteran Admiral title
Maritime/Battle Level 87
Completion of the Grand Admiral job card 4-part quest chain (Port Royal/Henry Morgan storyline)
Completion of a battle quest from Santo Domingo - Subduing Wanderers seems like the right one? It should give the job card for High Commander job.

Battle's not my specialty, so perhaps some others can fill in the blanks a bit better than I have. Cheers.

Source/quest data: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1116.html , gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=6187
